abstractEnglish: We prove that the ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every complex-valued function in $`L\log L`$ on the circle converge almost everywhere to the function along the full sequence. This establishes the classical $`L\log L`$ sufficiency conjecture.
titleEn: Almost-everywhere Fourier convergence in L log L
